summary: A ~39s finished 2015 Alligators Brno recruitment promo ('Nábor'), not raw footage — it opens on a Czech 'new season' title slate, intercuts real game action (a line-of-scrimmage hit, an open-field breakaway run, sideline scrums, a wide floodlit formation) with off-season training (bench press, agility drills, battle ropes), and closes on a recruitment CTA slate plus a static dated event poster. The athletic material is squarely on-brief — aggressive hits, speed, team pride, and the grind of conditioning — but nearly every action beat carries baked-in CAAF logos and Czech lower-thirds, and the two title cards plus the end poster are unusable as source frames. The open-field run (t≈23–26) and the tackle (t≈3–7) are the strongest reusable moments; the training cutaways add texture. Grade is cold/high-contrast throughout, resolution 1280x720.
